verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee ships several dedicated, ready-made scraper APIs (Amazon search/product/pricing, Walmart search/product, YouTube search/metadata/subtitles, Google search) that a developer can call directly instead of building a custom scraper, which partially satisfies the 'ready-made scraper' need. However, there is no evidence of an actual marketplace (e.g., community-contributed or third-party scraper listings) — these are first-party fixed endpoints, not a marketplace model. Missing for 10: a genuine marketplace of shareable/community scrapers, ability to browse/install third-party scrapers, and any independent confirmation of this workflow.
